svg.title: Fourteen contributing sites: eight IMAGEN and six cVEDA
svg.desc: Europe and India in separate geographic insets. NIMHANS and SJRI share Bengaluru; Rishi Valley participants also scanned at NIMHANS. Marker positions are approximate city or regional locations, not scanner addresses.
svg.text: NIMHANS + SJRI: Bengaluru · Rishi Valley: Andhra Pradesh
